newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end higher on select blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end higher on select blue chips.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Wednesday amid selective blue-chip buying by foreign brokerage houses, dealers said.

"The overall activity is slow but foreign brokerage houses have buying orders for some of the blue chips that are available at rock bottom prices," sales head at ING Baring Securities Sameer Ahmad said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 9.29 points, or 0.60 percent, to close at 1,554.70 at 0910 GMT. Losers led gainers 157-117. Shell Pakistan rose 2.0 rupees to 240 and PTCL 0.70 to 25.95. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
